description: `$where` takes a JavaScript EXPRESSION and MongoDB evaluates it on the server, so the caller's text is the caller's code -- the same judgement as eval, at a different interpreter. What names it is the OPTION rather than the method, and the negative is the identical method call with a field equality, which MongoDB compares and never evaluates.

expected.note: the option is the evidence; the same find() below carries a field equality and is silent
